title: Transformer
description: Foundational seq2seq architecture utilizing self-attention mechanism.
name: Transformer
summary: The Transformer is a sequence transduction architecture relying entirely on self-attention mechanisms to compute representations of its input and output without using sequence-aligned RNNs or convolutions.
use_when: Building machine translation, summarization, or text generation systems requiring long-range context modeling.
avoid_when: Working with short sequences under extreme edge latency budgets where small CNNs/LSTMs suffice.
pros: Allows massive parallelization during training, drastically outperforming LSTMs.
Natively models long-range sequence dependencies without signal degradation.
Serves as the foundational block for nearly all modern SOTA NLP/LLM models.
cons: Quadratic memory complexity O(L^2) with respect to input sequence length.
Requires massive scale datasets and compute budgets to train effectively from scratch.
Requires complex positional encodings because it possesses no natural inductive bias for sequence order.

key_hyperparams.name: n_heads
key_hyperparams.note: Number of multi-head attention components. Enables parallel modeling of diverse attention spaces.

quick_start:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

transformer_model = nn.Transformer(nhead=8, num_encoder_layers=6)
src = torch.rand((10, 32, 512))
tg = torch.rand((20, 32, 512))
out = transformer_model(src, tg)
